analysis.purpose: The structure phase: walks the repository into file nodes, skipping build, dependency, vendored and minified paths, and computes each file content hash once.
responsibilities: Walk the repository into file nodes
Apply the baseline ignore set and the repo own ignore rules
Skip vendored and minified artifacts, whose identifiers carry no meaning
Compute each content hash once for later phases

businessRules.rule: The baseline ignore set is hardcoded so a repo without ignore rules still skips universal noise, and no rule can re-include it.
businessRules.rationale: Dependency directories must never enter the graph, whatever the repo configures.

businessRules.rule: Minified and vendored files are skipped because their identifiers are mangled and unsearchable.
businessRules.rationale: They are code, but they are not knowledge.

nodes.name: Repository discovery
nodes.summary: What enters the graph, and what never does.
